# B-0035: first-request repository discoverability

Maintain the existing neutral repository coding host so a newly invoked coding
model can discover the complete host-authorized source surface without a separate
listing-only inference round. This is the concrete follow-up recorded in canonical
B-0035 after local coding Case 0002. Keep all existing public signatures and Tools.

Preserve the original objective as the first message. Include exactly one
JSON-encoded metadata message, with repository_id, snapshot_id, source_acquired
(false), and resources. Each resource has address, content_identity, byte_size and
editable (a boolean from the host's editable subset). Values correspond to the
current authenticated source scope, including UTF-8 sizes. Include every scoped
resource and no others. This is a transient model-facing projection, not a new
durable schema or source identity. Do not disclose resource content or absolute
host paths. Metadata does not acquire source, satisfy readiness or authorize edits.

Repeated preparation and complete-input continuation must not accumulate copies.
Preparation after admitted source refresh must describe the current snapshot.
Charge the complete metadata and existing Tools/continuation to the existing
Prompt byte bound; refuse over-budget requests rather than silently truncate or
omit resources. Preserve stale-source refusal, native call correlation, actual
source disclosure before edits, host admission, fixed checks, restoration,
candidate/terminal outcomes and all existing limits. No new registry, executor,
provider, file-search engine, generic type or Qwen-specific dependency is needed.

Inspect source with the authorized Tools, then submit grounded exact edits.
Tests, docs, configuration and experiment evidence are read-only. Only existing
Agents coding Python modules are editable. Do not change tests or checks, expand
scope, choose commands, publish, or implement other backlog work. Failed checks
will produce real bounded feedback; you may repair within the frozen limits.

Use list_repository/search_source to discover authorized files; read_source uses Unicode offsets and supports omitted end. Acquire current exact source before edits. Limits: eight requests, four proposals, at most three applied candidates (two validation-feedback repairs), twenty acquisition actions. Current repository.py is close to the unchanged 32768-byte resulting-source ceiling. No source/edit limits may be increased.

The `assert_metadata` in the experiment shows the exact expected metadata shape. Now let me understand how the host currently builds its first message. Let me read repository.py (the main editable file) and the test.

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class EditLimits:
    """Host-selected region/source/transaction ceilings, without Qwen defaults."""

    region_bytes: int
    source_bytes: int
    aggregate_bytes: int
    operations: int

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        """Refuse unbounded admission before effects."""
        if (
            min(
                self.region_bytes,
                self.source_bytes,
                self.aggregate_bytes,
                self.operations,
            )
            <= 0
        ):
            msg = "Edit limits must be positive."
            raise ValueError(msg)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class CodingObjective:
    """One bounded existing-text repair, with explicit host scope and checks.

    This concrete profile does not mandate Python, repository layout, provider,
    task JSON, public API oracle language, evidence storage or publication.
    """

    text: str
    scope: SourceScope
    editable: tuple[RepositoryResourceAddress, ...]
    checks: FixedCheckPlan
    edits: EditLimits
    disclosure_bytes: int
    prompt_bytes: int

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        """Require a finite editable subset of the authenticated host frame."""
        addresses = {r.address for r in self.scope.snapshot.resources}
        if (
            not self.text.strip()
            or not isinstance(self.editable, tuple)
            or not self.editable
            or len(set(self.editable)) != len(self.editable)
            or not set(self.editable) <= addresses
            or min(self.disclosure_bytes, self.prompt_bytes) <= 0
            or self.checks.root != self.scope.root
            or (
                self.checks.source_scope is not None
                and self.checks.source_scope != self.scope
            )
        ):
            msg = "Coding objective has an invalid or foreign source/check scope."
            raise ValueError(msg)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SourceChange:
    """Admitted whole after-image with its original addressed source and span."""

    address: RepositoryResourceAddress
    before: str
    after: str
    start: int
    end: int


def write_source_changes(root: ResolvedPath, changes: tuple[SourceChange, ...]) -> None:
    """Host-selectable effect using existing atomic Resource writes, not a transaction.

    Call only with an admitted batch. Earlier per-file effects may survive a
    later failure. Checkout serialization and permission belong to the host.
    """
    for change in changes:
        write(
            TextFile(
                resolve_path(change.address.value, base_directory=root.value),
                change.after,
            ),
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _Invocation[Input]:
    """One explicitly selected native operation, not a Tool registry."""

    descriptor: ToolDescriptor
    decode: Callable[[str], Input]

    def materialize(self, serialized_arguments: str) -> Input:
        """Delegate effect-free materialization to the selected host operation."""
        return self.decode(serialized_arguments)


class _ChangeTool:
    """Execute an already admitted source batch once through a host effect owner."""

    name = "apply_admitted_source"
    description = "Apply one host-admitted exact source batch."

    def __init__(
        self,
        scope: SourceScope,
        changes: tuple[SourceChange, ...],
        effect: Callable[[tuple[SourceChange, ...]], Awaitable[None]],
    ) -> None:
        self.scope, self.changes, self.effect = scope, changes, effect

    def validate(self, arguments: tuple[SourceChange, ...]) -> None:
        """Recheck admitted identities before invoking the host, never grant scope."""
        if arguments is not self.changes:
            msg = "Source batch is not the admitted proposal."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        self.scope.check_current()

    async def execute(self, arguments: tuple[SourceChange, ...]) -> None:
        """Invoke once; any exception can follow a completed external effect."""
        await self.effect(arguments)

    serialized: str,

) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Validate this host's small native argument object, not arbitrary JSON Schema."""

        value = dict(items)
        if len(value) != len(items):
            msg = "Duplicate coding argument member."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return value

    value = json.loads(serialized, object_pairs_hook=pairs)
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or not fields <= set(value) <= fields | optional:
        msg = "Coding arguments do not match the admitted operation."

def host_at(root: Path) -> RepositoryCodingHost:
    address = RepositoryResourceAddress("module.py")
    write(TextFile(resolve_path(root / address.value), SOURCE))
    repo = Repository.new()
    scope = SourceScope.observe(
        root=resolve_path(root),
        repository=repo,
        addresses=(address,),
    )
    corpus = define_repository_text_corpus(
        discovery=discover_repository_resource_addresses(
            repository=repo,
            root=scope.root,
            requested_addresses=(address,),
            maximum_resource_count=4,
            maximum_traversal_entry_count=128,
        ),
        selected_addresses=(address,),
    )
    plan = FixedCheckPlan(
        scope.root,
        (
            FixedCheck(
                "fixed",
                Command(sys.executable)
                .args("-I", "-c", "pass")
                .cwd(scope.root)
                .with_timeout(Duration.seconds(5)),
            ),
        ),
        scope,
    )
    objective = CodingObjective(
        "Return 7",
        scope,
        (address,),
        plan,
        EditLimits(1024, 1024, 2048, 4),
        1024,
        32768,
    )

    async def admit(_call: object, _arguments: object) -> None:
        return

    async def apply(changes: Any) -> None:  # noqa: ANN401 -- explicit admitted Tool boundary
        write_source_changes(scope.root, changes)

    def restore(selected: RepositoryResourceAddress, text: str | None) -> None:
        assert text is not None
        write(TextFile(resolve_path(root / selected.value), text))

    return RepositoryCodingHost(
        objective,
        corpus=corpus,
        authorize=admit,
        apply_changes=apply,
        archive=lambda _: None,
        restore=restore,
    )


def call(name: str, values: object, identity: str) -> ModelToolCall:
    return ModelToolCall(name, json.dumps(values), identity)

EDIT = call(

)
LIMITS = CodingLimits(4, 1, 4, Duration.seconds(5), Duration.seconds(20))


class Script:
    """Fixed native responses, with actual provider entry counts."""

    source = InteractionSource("independent-admission-controls")

    def __init__(self, calls: list[tuple[ModelToolCall, ...]]) -> None:
        """Retain a finite independently authored schedule."""
        self.calls = calls
        self.entries = 0

    async def send(self, _request: object) -> ModelResponse:
        """Return one normalized response without executing any Tool or edit."""
        selected = self.calls[self.entries]
        self.entries += 1
        return ModelResponse("literal", self.source, tool_calls=selected)

@pytest.mark.parametrize(

def test_invalid_objective_refused_before_model(tmp_path: Path, fault: str) -> None:
    host = host_at(tmp_path)
    value = host.objective
    changed: dict[str, Any] = (
        {"text": " "}

            {"editable": value.editable * 2}
            if fault == "duplicate"
            else {"editable": (RepositoryResourceAddress("other.py"),)}
            if fault == "foreign"
            else {"prompt_bytes": 0}
            if fault == "budget"
            else {
                "checks": replace(
                    value.checks,
                    source_scope=replace(
                        value.scope,
                        snapshot=replace(
                            value.scope.snapshot,
                            id=type(value.scope.snapshot.id)("0" * 64),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            }
        )
    )
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="scope"):

def test_foreign_corpus_refused(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    a, b = tmp_path / "a", tmp_path / "b"
    a.mkdir()
    b.mkdir()
    first, second = host_at(a), host_at(b)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="foreign repository"):
        RepositoryCodingHost(
            first.objective,
            corpus=second.corpus,
            authorize=first.authorize,
            apply_changes=first.effect,
            archive=first.archive,
            restore=first.restore,
        )


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "fault",
    ["prompt", "stop", "operation", "mixed", "members", "range"],
)
def test_request_and_native_admission(tmp_path: Path, fault: str) -> None:
    host = host_at(tmp_path)
    values = {
        "prompt": (READ,),
        "stop": (),
        "operation": (call("arbitrary_shell", {}, "unadmitted"),),
        "mixed": (READ, EDIT),
        "members": (call("read_source", {"path": "module.py"}, "members"),),
        "range": (
            call(
                "read_source",
                {"path": "module.py", "start": -1, "end": 100},
                "range",
            ),
        ),
    }
    if fault == "prompt":
        host.objective = replace(host.objective, prompt_bytes=1)
    model = Script([values[fault], ()] if fault == "range" else [values[fault]])
    result = asyncio.run(run_coding_agent(model, limits=LIMITS, host=host))
    assert not result.accepted
    assert result.progress.proposals == 0
    if fault == "range":
        assert result.progress.effects[0].acknowledged
        assert '"SOURCE_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS"' in host.messages[-2].content
        assert not host.disclosures
    else:
        assert result.progress.effects == [] or all(
            not e.acknowledged for e in result.progress.effects
        )
    assert result.disposition == ("stopped" if fault in {"stop", "range"} else "failed")
    assert model.entries == (0 if fault == "prompt" else 2 if fault == "range" else 1)
    assert (tmp_path / "module.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8") == SOURCE
